card.name: "After" before starting treatment
card.fires_on: The word "after" following a time span (weeks, months, days) and right before "starting" or "treatment initiation". It also fires on a few words in dose-escalation or start-of-therapy phrasing.

modes.label: Time span then after
modes.description: "After" comes after a number of weeks or months and points to the start of therapy, in monitoring or onset statements.
